description: Canonical ru terminology for recurring OmniRoute concepts. Consumed by scripts/i18n/check-glossary-consistency.mjs. Russian is an inflected language, so product/provider/model names must stay verbatim (Latin script) instead of being transliterated — machine translation produced renderings such as "Антропная совместимость" (anthropoid) for "Anthropic Compatible", "Клод" for "Claude", "Близнецы" for "Gemini" and "опенай" for "OpenAI". Every `protectedTermMistranslations` entry below was verified to have zero legitimate occurrences in the real ru catalog before being enforced.
